annotations.title: WHOIS lookup: who owns a domain

description: WHOIS lookup for a domain: registrar, creation and expiry date and age (RDAP/WHOIS), plus its DNS records and email setup (SPF, DMARC). Use to check who registered a domain, how old it is and where it is hosted, for lead research and phishing checks. Example: name=cloudflare.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
